summary.text: Renada Collins, an unaffiliated banking executive and entrepreneur from New Orleans, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Louisiana's 2nd Congressional District to Troy Carter Sr.
She says she entered the business world in 1999 and launched her own makeup line in 2005.

paragraphs.text: Collins, who is also known as "Honey" Collins, says she entered the business world in 1999 and launched her own makeup line in 2005.

Her Ballotpedia profile lists her profession as banking executive, while the Louisiana Illuminator's voter guide describes her as the executive director of a credit organization and business structuring firm.

She describes leading a group of ventures: Big Mouth Media Group, a media platform; Fresh Awakening, which focuses on spiritual, emotional, physical and economic growth; and the Chicken Scratch Journal Club, which works with authors.
Collins appeared on the ballot in the October 11, 2025 New Orleans mayoral primary, which Helena Moreno won outright with 54.9 percent.
During the campaign, she emphasized affordability, infrastructure investment and housing stability.
She received 1.2% of the vote to Troy Carter Sr.'s 79.9%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
